decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at C512-10 (radio and CMMS agree). Repair is likely 13:20, range 12:20 to 14:20. The stope holds 140 t at 13.4 g/t, about 60 oz. LH-08 is on the cheap infrastructure heading (0.5 oz/h) and is 0.69 h away. As an LH410 it loads 29.1 t/h, so it arrives about 10:00 and clears the 140 t in about 5 h, before 17:00. Central trucks have spare capacity (91 vs 63 t/h inflow), so the extra loader is not truck-limited. Cost is about 5.5 h x 0.5 = 2.8 oz of development. I did not take LH-09 because its heading is worth 2.0 oz/h. I did not take LH-07 because it would stop a producing stope.

Keep LH-08 at C512-10 (LH-01 down until ~13:20; 123 t @13.4 g ≈ 53 oz, 12.5 oz/h vs 0.5 dev cost; Central inflow ~ truck capacity). Lend LH-09 from preparation heading (2 oz/h) to N574-15 (LH-06 down until ~16:00): 147 t @9.4 g ≈ 44 oz, ~4.9 h load + 0.34 h travel; Norte inflow 33+30=63 < 66 truck cap. Net ≈ 44 - 11 ≈ 33. LH-10 PM until 14:00, too late.
